comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Docs say max 100; code says 50. Aligning code to 100 and adding a test that pageSize=100 returns 100 when enough rows exist.

content.text: Docs say max 100; code says 50. Aligning code to 100 and adding a test that pageSize=100 returns 100 when enough rows exist.
GET /v2/webhook-subscriptions ignores pageSize when the value is above 50. Clients requesting pageSize=100 still receive at most 50 items with no indication the parameter was clamped.

Expected: either honor pageSize up to the documented max of 100, or return 400 when out of range. Actual: the handler silently min(pageSize, 50) because an old constant MaxPageSize=50 was never raised when the public docs moved to 100.
Likely a mismatch between the OpenAPI maximum and the hard-coded clamp in listSubscriptions. Cursor generation still works, so clients must issue extra round-trips without knowing why.
Large workspaces with many subscriptions take twice the calls to list them all.
